_comment: Typical wake windows (time awake between sleeps) by age, for the Home screen's nap-window guide (issue #46). Sourced, never from memory — the same rule as the WHO LMS tables next to this file. Ages are month bounds [fromMonths, toMonths); minutes are the source's range verbatim. Beyond the last row the guide shows nothing rather than guess.

source.title: Wake Windows by Age
source.caveat: Babies are individuals. So, one baby's wake window may look a little different from another baby's. And your baby's wake windows may even look a little different from one day to the next.

framing.quote: Se etter tegn på tretthet, som gjesping, uro eller at barnet ser vekk.
framing.newborn: Våkenperiodene varer ofte bare 30 til 60 minutter.

notes: The source lists 3–4 months and 5–7 months with no 4–5 row; the 3–4 row (1.25–2.5 h) is carried to 5 months here so the guide has no hole, which errs on the shorter window.
The source stops at 12 months; so does this table.
